name: @pipeworx/mcp-useragent

tools.name: parse_user_agent
tools.description: Parse a User-Agent string into browser, OS, device type (mobile/tablet/desktop/bot) and a bot flag (keyless, offline, heuristic).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-useragent forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the useragent pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
